notes: purchase_price, purchase_date, current_market_value, photo, notes live on DynamicCollectionItem — NOT in custom_fields.
The 'model' field from Timepiece is stored as 'watch_model' to avoid collision with Python/ORM model naming conventions.
New field types introduced: 'select', 'boolean', 'json_list' — requires template renderer update (Phase 3).
Valuation uses TimepieceCollectionServices which calls watch_valuation.py MCP tool.
Valuation inputs: brand, reference_number, year (from custom_fields) + has_box, has_papers, condition_grade.

fields.name: brand
fields.label: Brand / Manufacture
fields.help_text: e.g. Patek Philippe, Rolex, A. Lange & Söhne

fields.name: serial_number
fields.label: Serial Number
fields.help_text: Private identifier — not shared in valuations

fields.name: case_material
fields.label: Case Material
fields.help_text: e.g. 18k Rose Gold, Oystersteel, Platinum, Titanium

fields.name: dial_color
fields.label: Dial Color
fields.help_text: e.g. Sunburst Blue, Panda White, Salmon

fields.name: complications
fields.label: Complications
fields.help_text: Enter complications separated by commas: Chronograph, GMT, Moonphase

fields.name: has_box
fields.label: Original Box
fields.help_text: Includes the manufacturer's original box (+10% valuation)

fields.name: has_papers
fields.label: Original Papers
fields.help_text: Includes warranty card and documentation (+10% valuation)

fields.name: condition_grade
fields.label: Condition Grade
fields.help_text: Overall state of the watch — used in valuation calculation
